key_findings: Homepage CMS integration broken - admin changes don't affect live site
Image optimization timeouts causing 500 errors (20s+ load times)
Missing RLS policies on 5 critical database tables
TypeScript 'any' usage in 50+ locations reduces type safety
immediate_actions_required: Fix homepage CMS integration to use all sections

critical.title: Homepage CMS Integration Broken
critical.description: The homepage only uses the hero section from CMS. Features, activities, testimonials, and CTA sections are fetched but ignored, rendering hardcoded content instead. Admin editor shows content that never appears on the live site.
critical.impact: CMS system non-functional for homepage. Admin changes don't affect live site. Misleading admin experience.

affected_files.issue: Only extracts hero section from CMS data, ignores other sections
Returns all 5 sections but only hero is used

evidence.api_response: Returns 5 sections: hero, features, activities, testimonials, cta
evidence.actual_usage: Only hero section rendered, others ignored

critical.recommendation: Update app/page.tsx to consume all CMS sections. Replace hardcoded components with CMS-driven rendering.

critical.title: Image Optimization Timeouts
critical.description: Next.js image optimization requests timing out after 20+ seconds, resulting in 500 errors. Supabase storage images not loading correctly.
critical.impact: Poor UX, failed image loads, high bounce rate on image-heavy pages.

affected_files.issue: Image optimization config may need timeout adjustments

evidence.timeout_error: [Error [TimeoutError]: The operation was aborted due to timeout]

critical.recommendation: Add timeout config to next.config.js, consider using Supabase CDN directly, or implement image caching layer.

critical.title: Missing Database RLS Policies
critical.description: Multiple CMS and content tables lack Row Level Security policies, potentially allowing unauthorized data access.
critical.impact: Security vulnerability. Unauthorized users may read/write sensitive data.

affected_files.issue: Missing RLS policies for homepage_content, page_sections, page_versions, media_library, cms_settings

critical.recommendation: Create SQL migration to enable RLS on all CMS tables and add appropriate policies for public read and admin write access.

critical.title: Google Places API Key Not Configured
critical.description: Google Places API key missing from environment, causing reviews functionality to degrade to fallback defaults.
critical.impact: Real customer reviews not displayed. Misleading social proof.

affected_files.issue: Falls back to default reviews when API key missing

evidence.console_warning: Google Places API key not configured

critical.recommendation: Add GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY to .env.local and configure proper fallback handling.

high_priority.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Public Endpoints
high_priority.description: Most public API endpoints lack rate limiting, making them vulnerable to abuse and DDoS attacks.
high_priority.impact: API abuse, resource exhaustion, potential service disruption.
high_priority.recommendation: Apply rateLimiter middleware to all public endpoints with appropriate limits per endpoint type.

high_priority.title: Inconsistent Error Response Envelopes
high_priority.description: API routes return errors in different formats, making frontend error handling fragile and inconsistent.
high_priority.impact: Poor developer experience, fragile error handling, potential bugs.

affected_files.issue: Some use {success, error}, others {error, details}, others {message}

high_priority.recommendation: Standardize all API routes to use handleApiError from lib/error-handler.ts.

high_priority.title: Missing Input Validation on Several Endpoints
high_priority.description: Some POST/PUT endpoints lack Zod validation, allowing invalid data to reach the database.
high_priority.impact: Data integrity issues, potential SQL injection, application errors.
high_priority.recommendation: Add Zod validation using existing validators or create new ones for all POST/PUT endpoints.

high_priority.title: Missing ARIA Labels and Keyboard Navigation
high_priority.description: Multiple interactive components lack proper ARIA labels and keyboard support, failing WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
high_priority.impact: Inaccessible to screen reader users and keyboard-only users. Legal compliance risk.

affected_files.issue: File upload button not keyboard accessible
Drag handle not keyboard accessible, missing ARIA labels

high_priority.recommendation: Add ARIA labels, keyboard event handlers, and focus management to all interactive components.

high_priority.title: Missing Loading States on Async Operations
high_priority.description: Several components don't show loading indicators during async operations, leaving users uncertain.
high_priority.impact: Poor UX, users don't know if action is processing, potential duplicate submissions.

affected_files.issue: No loading state during form submission
No loading state during image fetch

high_priority.recommendation: Add loading state with disabled buttons and loading indicators to all async operations.

high_priority.title: Missing Error States on Data Fetching
high_priority.description: Components don't handle fetch errors gracefully, resulting in blank screens or generic errors.
high_priority.impact: Poor UX, users see blank screens, no recovery mechanism.

affected_files.issue: No error handling for CMS fetch failures
No error handling for room fetch failures

high_priority.recommendation: Add error state with user-friendly messages and retry mechanism to all data fetching.

high_priority.title: Missing Database Indexes
high_priority.description: Frequently queried columns lack indexes, causing slow queries as data grows.
high_priority.impact: Poor performance, slow page loads, high database CPU usage.

affected_files.issue: Missing indexes on bookings(check_in_date, check_out_date, status), page_sections(page_slug, is_active), media_library(file_type, category)

high_priority.recommendation: Create migration to add indexes on frequently filtered and joined columns.

high_priority.title: Missing Foreign Key Constraints
high_priority.description: Tables lack foreign key constraints, allowing orphaned records and data integrity issues.
high_priority.impact: Data integrity issues, orphaned records, inconsistent state.

affected_files.issue: Missing FK constraints on bookings.client_id, bookings.room_id, page_sections.page_id

high_priority.recommendation: Add foreign key constraints with appropriate ON DELETE behavior.

high_priority.title: Missing Check Constraints
high_priority.description: Tables lack check constraints for business rules, allowing invalid data.
high_priority.impact: Invalid data in database, application errors, data quality issues.

affected_files.issue: Missing constraints: bookings.check_out > check_in, bookings.guests > 0, rooms.capacity > 0

high_priority.recommendation: Add check constraints to enforce business rules at database level.

high_priority.title: No API Response Caching
high_priority.description: Static or slowly-changing data fetched on every request without caching.
high_priority.impact: Slow response times, high database load, poor performance.
high_priority.recommendation: Add Next.js revalidate and Cache-Control headers to appropriate endpoints.

high_priority.title: Large JavaScript Bundle Size
high_priority.description: Admin code included in public bundle, heavy components not lazy loaded.
high_priority.impact: Slow initial page load, poor performance on slow connections.
high_priority.recommendation: Implement dynamic imports for admin panel and heavy components.

high_priority.title: Hardcoded Design Values
high_priority.description: Colors, spacing, and typography hardcoded throughout codebase instead of using design tokens.
high_priority.impact: Inconsistent design, difficult to maintain, hard to theme.

affected_files.issue: Hardcoded colors like 'orange-500', spacing values, font sizes

high_priority.recommendation: Create design tokens system and replace all hardcoded values.

medium_priority.title: Excessive TypeScript 'any' Usage
medium_priority.description: 50+ instances of 'any' type reducing type safety and catching potential bugs.
medium_priority.impact: Lost type safety, potential runtime errors not caught at compile time.
medium_priority.recommendation: Define proper interfaces and types to replace all 'any' usage.

medium_priority.title: Unused Variables and Imports
medium_priority.description: 100+ ESLint warnings for unused variables, imports, and dead code.
medium_priority.impact: Code bloat, confusion, harder to maintain.
medium_priority.recommendation: Run ESLint auto-fix and manually remove remaining unused code.

medium_priority.title: Insufficient Test Coverage
medium_priority.description: Critical business logic functions lack unit tests, integration tests incomplete.
medium_priority.impact: Regressions not caught, low confidence in changes, bugs in production.

affected_files.issue: Pricing calculation logic not fully tested
Edge cases not covered in tests

medium_priority.recommendation: Add unit tests for all business logic, aim for 80%+ coverage.

medium_priority.title: Unoptimized Images
medium_priority.description: Not all images use Next.js Image component, missing responsive sizes and lazy loading.
medium_priority.impact: Slow page loads, high bandwidth usage, poor LCP scores.

affected_files.issue: Some img tags instead of Image component

medium_priority.recommendation: Replace all img tags with Next.js Image component, add responsive sizes.

medium_priority.title: Missing Focus Indicators
medium_priority.description: Custom components don't show visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation.
medium_priority.impact: Poor keyboard navigation UX, accessibility violation.

affected_files.issue: Focus ring not visible on all variants

medium_priority.recommendation: Add visible focus indicators to all interactive elements.

medium_priority.title: Color Contrast Issues
medium_priority.description: Some text/background combinations don't meet WCAG AA contrast ratios.
medium_priority.impact: Hard to read for users with visual impairments, accessibility violation.

affected_files.issue: Light text on light backgrounds in some states

medium_priority.recommendation: Audit all color combinations, ensure 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.

medium_priority.title: Missing Audit Columns
medium_priority.description: Tables lack created_by/updated_by columns for audit trail.
medium_priority.impact: Can't track who made changes, poor audit trail.
medium_priority.recommendation: Add audit columns to all CMS tables.

medium_priority.title: No Soft Delete Support
medium_priority.description: Tables use hard deletes, making data recovery impossible.
medium_priority.impact: Accidental deletions can't be recovered, data loss risk.
medium_priority.recommendation: Add deleted_at column and update delete operations to soft delete.

medium_priority.title: Missing CORS Configuration
medium_priority.description: API routes don't explicitly configure CORS headers.
medium_priority.impact: Potential CORS issues, unclear security posture.
medium_priority.recommendation: Add CORS middleware with explicit allowed origins.

medium_priority.title: Missing Security Headers
medium_priority.description: API responses lack security headers like X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options.
medium_priority.impact: Vulnerable to certain attacks, security best practices not followed.

affected_files.issue: Security headers present but may need review

medium_priority.recommendation: Audit and enhance security headers in next.config.js.

medium_priority.title: Inconsistent Form Validation Messages
medium_priority.description: Form validation messages vary in format and helpfulness across components.
medium_priority.impact: Confusing UX, users don't understand what's wrong.
medium_priority.recommendation: Standardize validation message format and improve clarity.

medium_priority.title: No Optimistic UI Updates
medium_priority.description: UI doesn't update optimistically during async operations, feels sluggish.
medium_priority.recommendation: Implement optimistic UI updates for common operations.

medium_priority.title: No Database Connection Pooling
medium_priority.description: Supabase client may not be using connection pooling efficiently.
medium_priority.recommendation: Review and configure Supabase connection pooling settings.

medium_priority.title: No Request Deduplication
medium_priority.description: Multiple components may fetch same data simultaneously without deduplication.

affected_files.issue: No SWR or React Query for request deduplication

medium_priority.recommendation: Implement SWR or React Query for data fetching.

medium_priority.title: Insufficient Error Logging
medium_priority.description: Errors logged to console but not sent to monitoring service.
medium_priority.impact: Production errors not tracked, hard to diagnose issues.

affected_files.issue: No integration with error tracking service

medium_priority.recommendation: Integrate Sentry or similar error tracking service.

medium_priority.title: No Performance Monitoring
medium_priority.description: No tracking of Core Web Vitals or API performance metrics.
medium_priority.impact: Can't identify performance regressions, no baseline metrics.
medium_priority.recommendation: Add Web Vitals reporting and API performance tracking.

medium_priority.title: Missing API Documentation
medium_priority.description: API endpoints lack documentation, making integration difficult.
medium_priority.impact: Poor developer experience, hard to integrate.
medium_priority.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI documentation for all API endpoints.

medium_priority.title: Insufficient Code Comments
medium_priority.description: Complex business logic lacks explanatory comments.
medium_priority.impact: Hard to understand and maintain code.
medium_priority.recommendation: Add JSDoc comments to all public functions and complex logic.

low_priority.title: Inconsistent Code Formatting
low_priority.description: Some files use different indentation, quote styles.

low_priority.title: Magic Numbers in Code
low_priority.recommendation: Extract magic numbers to named constants.

low_priority.title: No Favicon Variants
low_priority.description: Missing dark mode favicon, touch icons.
low_priority.recommendation: Add favicon variants for different contexts.

low_priority.title: Missing Structured Data
low_priority.description: No JSON-LD structured data for rich snippets.
low_priority.recommendation: Add structured data for Organization, LocalBusiness.

low_priority.title: Incomplete Meta Tags
low_priority.description: Some pages missing Open Graph or Twitter Card meta tags.
low_priority.recommendation: Add complete meta tags to all pages.

low_priority.title: No Service Worker
low_priority.description: No offline support or background sync.
low_priority.recommendation: Consider adding service worker for offline support.

low_priority.title: No Dark Mode Support
low_priority.recommendation: Implement dark mode with system preference detection.

low_priority.title: No Skeleton Loaders
low_priority.description: Loading states use spinners instead of skeleton screens.

low_priority.title: No Internationalization
low_priority.recommendation: Implement i18n with next-intl or similar.

low_priority.title: No Visual Regression Tests
low_priority.description: No automated visual testing for UI changes.
low_priority.recommendation: Add Chromatic or Percy for visual regression testing.

low_priority.title: No Staging Environment
low_priority.recommendation: Set up staging environment on Netlify.

low_priority.title: No Analytics Tracking
low_priority.description: No Google Analytics or similar tracking.

immediate_actions: Fix homepage CMS integration to use all sections from database
Resolve image optimization timeouts by adjusting Next.js config or using Supabase CDN
Add RLS policies to all CMS tables
short_term: Add rate limiting to all public API endpoints
Standardize error response envelopes across all routes
Add input validation to all POST/PUT endpoints
Fix accessibility issues (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)
Add loading and error states to all components
medium_term: Add database indexes, constraints, and audit columns
Reduce bundle size with code splitting
long_term: Upgrade admin panel to match wavecampdashboard standards
